comment: Which shipped skill covers a file of this project, so that .claude/hooks/skill-check.py can remind the session of it when the file is edited or a shell command names it. 'paths' are globs relative to the project root; 'content' are regular expressions matched against the text of an RDF file (.ttl, .trig, .nt, .ttl.graph, .ttl.imports), as it will be after the edit; 'exclude' are globs that take a file out of the rule again, because * in a glob also crosses '/'. A rule applies when any path or content pattern matches and no exclude does. A skill the project does not have in .claude/skills/ is skipped. A project switches the reminders off with an empty .claude/no-skill-check. This file belongs to the template - add project specific rules, and rules for skills of your own, to .claude/skill-map.custom.json in the same format; task check:offline validates it.
